purpose: Preserve the failed/revised initial diagnostic-check history of investigation seed0-investigation-01. All values below are exact outputs from this session's Pi tool calls, verifiable in the retained raw session log week8-support/part4-seed0-investigation/pi-investigate-02.jsonl (each value string-matched in that file on 2026-10-28). These are diagnostic-engineering checks; they are explicitly DISTINCT from the unchanged scientific gates of the formal runs (test acc >= 0.99, delay > 10, top-5 share > 0.8, ablation gates), which remain unmet for seed 0.

entries.initial_criterion: max absolute parameter diff <= 1e-6 over 200 steps

revision.what: criterion changed to scale-relative: max abs diff / max(max|ref param|, 1e-3) <= 1e-5
revision.justification: This is a revised diagnostic metric for a float32-versus-float64 multi-step comparison, not proof that the original tolerance was wrong or that the optimizer is correct. The first failure is retained; the independent matched-float64 comparison of parameters and both moments supplies the stronger formula check. The scientific gates were not changed.
revision.revised_result: PASS, worst scale-relative diff 5.385181412126752e-06, worst absolute 4.405370918725282e-06 (unchanged measurement, changed tolerance metric)
revision.residual_interpretation: remaining diff is consistent with float32 JAX accumulation over 200 steps vs float64 reference; NOT evidence of a formula error

entries.stated_limitation: the original diag01 implementation compared only final parameters; it did NOT compare the m and v optimizer states. This limitation is acknowledged; Codex independently closed it.

exact_values.compared: parameters and both moment states (m, v) at every step

entries.note: closes the diag01 state-comparison gap at tolerance 1e-12 in float64

revision.what: criterion changed to standard mixed form |fd - ad| <= 1e-6 + 1e-3*|ad|, and offenders stored
revision.justification: the purely relative metric is inflated near tiny gradients (denominator ~1e-8); the mixed absolute+relative form is the standard finite-difference check

entries.stated_limitation: this checks autodiff gradients at the 128 tested points only; it does NOT test or eliminate float32 training-dynamics effects over 10000 steps

entries.initial_criterion: sign-flipped gradient rejected by finite differences
entries.diagnosis: the finite difference returned exactly 0.0 while the analytic gradient was ~8.9e-3: float32 loss quantization (loss ~4.6, float32 resolution ~4e-7) made the expected loss change (~1.8e-7) unresolvable, so the control passed for a spurious reason and was rejected as uninformative
entries.revision: control redone with jax_enable_x64 (v1-x64, preserved as diag07_negative_controls_v1-x64.py / results/diag07_negative_controls_v1-x64.json), then made robust as diag08

entries.residual_limitation: NC3 still used a single h and a moderate gradient; superseded by diag08

entries.cause: criterion bug in the diagnostic itself (required every cross-seed same-acc step > 2000; seed 4 reached seed 0's final accuracy at step 1700, which is valid lag evidence, not a failure)
entries.revision: criterion corrected to 'all same-acc steps defined and < 10000'; the underlying measurements were unchanged; recorded for transparency

raw_evidence.verification: each exact value above was string-matched in the retained session log on 2026-10-28; no value reconstructed from memory
